title: Creamy Steak Pasta
summary: An indulgent creation marrying seared beef with Bourssin cheese sauce. Comfort food elegant enough for guests.

steps.text: Mix cheese with garlic, parsley, herbs (if using), salt and pepper. Set aside at room temperature.
Pat ribeye steak completely dry, season generously with salt and pepper.

Heat large pan over high heat. Add oil. Sear steak whole, 2-3 minutes per side until well browned and cooked to your liking. Remove to plate, rest 5 minutes, then slice into strips. Lower heat to medium.
Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente. Do not drain.
Add onion to pan, fry 3-4 minutes until soft and golden.
Pour in stock, bring to simmer. Stir in mascarpone mixture until melted. Add Parmesan, parsley, and steak resting juices. Simmer gently.
Transfer pasta to pan with tongs, bringing pasta water. Toss vigorously until sauce clings. Add more water for silky consistency.
Add steak strips, toss gently. Finish with Parmesan and parsley. Serve immediately.

tips: Cream cheese is a good substitute for Boursin Cheese. Do not overcrowd pan when searing (meat tastes better when well seared !). Transfer pasta directly to sauce with tongs - pasta water binds everything together.
